I will keep this small maize plot the way I can manage with my own hands and little cash. My land is mine, so I do put dung and compost when I have it, but this plot is too small for me to buy chemical fertilizer unless I can share with someone, and most times I do not. I will plant the seed I know, weed it by hand, and depend on the rain because I have no water to irrigate and I cannot spend money on spray for such a small piece.
